utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Just the quick version, please—I’m still catching up.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sure — I can keep it brief and just give the essentials. What part do you want first: date, time, or meeting spot?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: The meeting spot first, please — I’m still catching up.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Opal — I’m still happy to help with the repair drive and can bring the sign-up list. Saturday at 10 a.m. still seems like a good fit if that works for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Mara — Saturday at 10 a.m. works for me, and the sign-up list will be really helpful. I’ll keep the porch rail fix on the list and make sure Jules stays connected with you.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great — I’ll keep the sign-up list simple and be ready Saturday at 10. Thanks for keeping Jules in the loop, Opal.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No problem, Noah — just send me the list when you’ve got it, and I’ll round up the tools.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Gus — I’ll get the list together and send it over soon.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Noah — I’ll be ready when your list comes in.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Vik — no rush. Just let me know what’s left, and I can help with the tools or missing list.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll check what’s left and keep spreading the word so neighbors know the date.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Vik — that helps. I’ll stay ready to sort the tools and help with the missing list once you’ve got the details.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Kira — I’m keeping the supply list in order and making sure we’re ready for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great — can you confirm the date, drop-off spot, and whether there are any costs or volunteer times?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll check the details and get back to you — I know we’re keeping the supply list ready, but I don’t want to guess on the date, drop-off spot, or costs.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — if you’re heading to the repair drive, I’ll spread the word and see who else can come along.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Quinn — that’d be a big help. I’m mainly trying to get the urgent fixes covered first, so any extra hands spreading the word would really make a difference.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: You got it — I’ll start rallying a few neighbors right away and keep it focused on those urgent fixes.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great — please sort the donated tools and label the boxes first. If you finish early, check the high-traffic spots for anything obvious.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Got it — I’ll sort the tools and label the boxes first, then check the high-traffic spots if there’s time. I’m still keeping an eye on the schedule, since timing matters too.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — keep the schedule tight, and flag anything urgent as you see it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It’s going well—people have been pitching in, and the porch rail is the main thing still left. I’m coordinating with Mara on it now.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks—could you confirm the date, time, and where we’re meeting? I want to make sure I’ve got the details right before I say yes.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’m just confirming the date, time, and meeting spot with Mara, and I’ll pass them along as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll keep the urgent safety fixes first, then the high-traffic spots. If you know of any trouble areas, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can do that—I'll sort the donated tools and make a missing list. If you want, I can also check what we already have on hand.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That would be a huge help, Rey — please sort the donated tools and check what we already have on hand, then send me the missing list.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’ll ask around and see if the schedule’s been set yet, and whether they still need tools or boxes. I’ll let you know as soon as I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Tess. I appreciate you checking — I’m still thinking it over, but I’d like to know what they need.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Of course — I’ll ask and bring you the latest as soon as I hear back. If they still need anything, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I’ll start with the unsafe ones first — leaks and wiring. If you have any new requests, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds like a solid plan, Mina. I’ll keep my list organized and send you anything else that comes up.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Perfect — I’ll keep triaging the urgent ones first, and you can send the rest as they come in.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep — send over the date, what needs fixing, where to drop things off, and any costs or volunteer times, and I’ll take a quick look.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I’ll send over the repair drive details and any times or costs I have.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, thanks — send it over when you can and I’ll skim it fast.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — if you decide to go, I’ll spread the word and start rallying a few neighbors right away.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm the date and the exact details you want me to share?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I don’t have the date pinned down yet, but I’m checking and will send you the exact details as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m still checking for the biggest safety issues first — leaks and wiring are at the top of the list. If you hear of anything urgent, send it my way.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Got it — I’ll keep spreading the word and send you anything urgent I hear about. I’ll also check what’s left on my end and get back to you soon.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Vik — I appreciate it. I’ll keep sorting the urgent ones and let you know if I hear anything important.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Rey — I’ll keep it simple and bring a clear list when it’s time.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That works — I’ll start sorting the tools and make a missing list.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great, Rey — I’ll stick to the list and come by when you’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me of the repair drive details? I want to make sure I’ve got everything right before I say yes.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sure — we’re aiming for Saturday morning at 10 a.m., and it should fit around school pickup. Bo’s making a simple sign-up list and helping spread the word, and I’ll coordinate the schedule.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks — can you confirm where we’re meeting, too?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Just the quick version, please—I’m still catching up.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure — send me the date, what needs fixing, where to drop things off, and any costs or volunteer times.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, got it — I’ll pass that along and keep an eye out for the dates and drop-off info.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Got it — I’ll reach out to Mara about the porch rail and see what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good — if you want, I can help double-check the repair drive details once Mara replies.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Dane — I’d appreciate that. I’ll check in with Mara and loop you in once I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — Pia, what still needs doing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m mostly trying to confirm the timing and what practical items they still need. If they’re short on tools or sturdy boxes, I can help keep an eye out.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Pia — if you spot any sturdy boxes or tools, could you let me know? I’ll keep an eye out too, once I’ve got the list.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Leo — I’m keeping track of the repair drive locations, so send me any updates and I’ll log them.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — I’ll send updates as I get them. Right now, the tool boxes still need sorting and labeling.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Leo — I’ve got the tool boxes on my list. Send me the location when you know it, and I’ll keep it updated.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Sam — I’m still thinking it through, but I appreciate the help if I do go.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Of course — no rush, and I’m here if you decide to go or need anything sorted out.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Sam. I’ll let you know once I’ve made up my mind.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I can check on the timing and see if they still need tools or boxes, then let you know as soon as I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Tess — timing’s the main thing. Please let me know if they still need tools or boxes, too.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely — I’ll check on the schedule and whether they still need tools or boxes, and I’ll pass it along as soon as I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Cleo — I’ve been meaning to check on the repair drive. Could you tell me what’s still left to sort out?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m keeping an eye on the supply list, and the main thing left is making sure we’ve got everything ready for the repairs. The loose front steps by my porch should stay near the top of the list too.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, thanks, Cleo — I’ll keep the front steps high on the list and check what supplies are still missing. If you spot anything else needed, let me know and I’ll sort it out.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Mara — send me the list when you’ve got it, and I’ll round up the tools for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Gus — I’ll put the sign-up list together and send it over soon. Appreciate you rounding up the tools.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Mara — just send it over when you’re ready, and I’ll have the tools lined up.
